notes.title: News #1 First Big Milestone! 🚀
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549912/b1e43d6656c5ebed8caa7960e73e6465d10994a5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve recently hit a major milestone: our [b]first closed playtest is live[/b]! 🚀

Alongside it, we launched a brand-new [b]trailer[/b] and [b]fresh screenshots[/b] on the Steam page — check them out if you haven’t yet.

The playtest went really well and we're making steady progress with the game - there’s still plenty of features and polishing ahead but the next playtest should be even bigger - so stay tuned for future news!

To celebrate, we’ve put together a small gift for you: a set of AstroScaper wallpapers to bring a little cosmic charm to your desktop. You can grab the files right here: \[[url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18a0Qf_xDLMnUqMU8lpTNxg2WbNNFjJ6A?usp=sharing"]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18a0Qf_xDLMnUqMU8lpTNxg2WbNNFjJ6A?usp=sharing[/url]][/p][p]
We promise that this is just the beginning and more updates are on the way. And if you know someone who might enjoy what we’re building, please share our Steam page — it truly means the world to us 💫

Jarek & Jacek[/p]
